详情标签页（光标不在输入框里时）: Detail tab (when the cursor is not in a text field)
依赖图（光标不在输入框里时；拖动空白处平移，滚轮缩放）: Dependency view (when the cursor is not in a text field; drag empty space to pan, scroll to zoom)
跳到搜索框（在别的页面会先回到看板）: Jump to the search box (from other pages, goes back to the board first)
新建 issue（在别的页面会先回到看板）: New issue (from other pages, goes back to the board first)
立即同步（详情标签页在前时：重新读这一条，同详情的刷新按钮）: Sync now (with a detail tab in front: read that item again, like the detail's refresh button)
切到看板（在别的页面会先回到看板）: Switch to the board (from other pages, goes back to the board first)
切到表格（在别的页面会先回到看板）: Switch to the table (from other pages, goes back to the board first)
切到依赖图（在别的页面会先回到看板）: Switch to the dependency view (from other pages, goes back to the board first)
关掉当前标签页（在首页时：macOS 关窗，别的系统不做事）: Close the current tab (on the home tab: closes the window on macOS, does nothing elsewhere)
切到第几个标签页（1 是首页，9 是最后一个；只有首页时不做事）: Go to tab by number (1 is the home tab, 9 the last one; does nothing when only the home tab is open)
关闭 issue（只打开选原因的确认框；回复框、讨论区里也能按）: Close issue (only opens the dialog to pick a reason; also works in the reply box and the discussion)
交给 agent（回复框、讨论区里也能按；回复框里有字时先作为评论发出，发成功后: Hand to agent (also works in the reply box and the discussion; text in the reply box is sent as a comment first, and the label changes once it went through)
托管（自动合并；设置里开着确认时先弹确认框；回复框、讨论区里也能按；回复框里有字: Autopilot (merges automatically; asks first when confirmation is on in settings; also works in the reply box and the discussion; text in the reply box is sent as a comment first)
等前置（打开选前置的对话框；回复框、讨论区里也能按）: Wait for prerequisites (opens the dialog to pick them; also works in the reply box and the discussion)
回到首页（标签页留着，没发出的文字也留着）: Back to the home tab (the tab stays open, and so does any unsent text)
适应窗口（整张图放进窗口）: Fit to window (the whole graph in view)
回到看板（光标在输入框里时，先离开输入框并保存）: Back to the board (with the cursor in a text field: leaves the field and saves first)
离开回复框（文字保留）: Leave the reply box (the text is kept)
确认（创建 / 关闭 / 合并 / 托管 / 加入看板）: Confirm (create / close / merge / Autopilot / add to board)
取消（新建 issue 里有字时不取消）: Cancel (not while a new issue has text in it)
新建 issue：交给 agent（加上派工标签并创建；标题、正文里也能按）: New issue: Hand to agent (adds the dispatch label and creates it; also works in the title and body)
新建 issue：托管（设置里开着确认时先弹确认框；标题、正文里也能按）: New issue: Autopilot (asks first when confirmation is on in settings; also works in the title and body)
在页面上查找文字（不动搜索框；查找栏已开着时：回到查找栏并选中里面的字）: Find text on the page (leaves the search box alone; with the find bar open: goes back to it and selects its text)
查找：下一处（查找栏开着时；讨论区里也能按）: Find: next match (while the find bar is open; also works in the discussion)
查找：上一处（查找栏开着时；讨论区里也能按）: Find: previous match (while the find bar is open; also works in the discussion)
关掉查找栏、去掉高亮（查找栏开着时，在页面上、讨论区里按 Esc 也是先关它）: Close the find bar and clear highlights (while it is open, Esc on the page or in the discussion closes it first)
这个操作的键是固定的，不能改: This action's key is fixed and cannot be changed
Esc、↩、Tab、空格、退格和方向键有固定用途，换一个键: Esc, ↩, Tab, Space, Backspace and the arrow keys have fixed uses; pick another key
macOS 把 {key} 留给锁屏 / 全屏，换一个: macOS keeps {key} for lock screen / full screen; pick another
按住 ⌥ / Alt 时只能配字母或数字: With ⌥ / Alt held, only a letter or digit can be used
{key} 是菜单里的缩放键，换一个: {key} is the menu's zoom key; pick another
{key} 由系统使用（退出 / 隐藏 / 最小化），换一个: {key} is used by the system (quit / hide / minimize); pick another
{key} 是输入框里的编辑键（复制 / 粘贴 / 剪切 / 全选 / 撤销），: {key} is an editing key in text fields (copy / paste / cut / select all / undo); pick another
macOS 把 {key} 留给截图，窗口收不到，换一个: macOS keeps {key} for screenshots, so the window never gets it; pick another
这个操作在输入框里也要能按，新键必须带 ⌘ / Ctrl: This action must also work in text fields, so the new key needs ⌘ / Ctrl
恢复不了：默认键 {key} 现在是「{other}」的键，恢复后两个操作会抢同: Cannot restore: the default key {key} now belongs to "{other}", and both actions would share it. Change "{other}" or restore its default first, then restore this one.
{key} 已经是「{other}」的快捷键，会撞车。换一个键，或先把「{oth: {key} is already the shortcut for "{other}". Pick another key, or change "{other}" first.
保存的内容读不出来: The saved settings could not be read
这个版本没有这个操作: This version has no such action
保存的键读不出来: The saved key could not be read
单个字母的快捷键只在光标不在输入框里时生效；输入法正在拼字时，快捷键一律不响应。: Single-letter shortcuts only work when the cursor is not in a text field; while an input method is composing, no shortcut responds. Zoom in / zoom out / actual size are in the "Zoom" menu (⌘= / ⌘- / ⌘0). After clicking in the discussion, the keyboard stays there: click somewhere outside the discussion first.
没有保存上，再按一次试试: Not saved; try pressing it again
点「改」后按下新的按键。改了只在这台电脑上生效；一个操作改成一个键，原来的键随之: Click "Change", then press the new key. Changes apply on this computer only; an action gets one key, and its old keys stop working. Esc, ↩, the arrow keys, {mod}1 … {mod}9, {mod}W and the zoom keys are fixed. A single key without {modKey} only works when the cursor is not in a text field.

上次保存的快捷键里有 {n} 项这次不能用，已按默认处理：{list}。这一项改.one: {n} saved shortcut cannot be used this time and has its default key: {list}. This note goes away once it is changed or restored.
上次保存的快捷键里有 {n} 项这次不能用，已按默认处理：{list}。这一项改.other: {n} saved shortcuts cannot be used this time and have their default keys: {list}. This note goes away once they are changed or restored.

不带 {mod} 的键在回复框里按是打字: A key without {mod} types text in the reply box
不带 {mod} 的键在回复框、讨论区里按不生效: A key without {mod} does nothing in the reply box or the discussion
往左看更多标签页: Show more tabs to the left
往右看更多标签页: Show more tabs to the right
有没提交的内容，按 Esc 不会丢掉；点「取消」才会丢掉。: There is unsubmitted text: Esc will not discard it; click "Cancel" to discard it.
会加上标签{list}，建好后 daemon 派给 agent: Adds the label {list}; once created, the daemon hands it to the agent
会加上标签{list}：agent 从方案到合并不再等人确认，复审和检查通过后由: Adds the labels {list}: the agent goes from plan to merge without waiting for anyone, and the daemon merges once review and checks pass. To stop it, remove "{first}" on the web page
读不到仓库 {repo} 的标签，暂时不能确认标签在不在（{error}）: Could not read the labels of {repo}, so it is not known yet whether the labels exist ({error})
设置里没有填托管标签: No Autopilot label is set in Settings
上次是按「{button}」建的，没有建成；要照旧交接，再按下面对应的按钮: Last time this was created with "{button}" and did not go through; to hand it over the same way, press that button below again
建好后加入这些看板: Add to these boards once created
一个都不勾 = 不加入任何看板: None ticked = not added to any board
已添加的看板都还没同步完，现在没法勾选；同步完后这里会列出来: None of the added boards has finished syncing, so none can be ticked yet; they will be listed here once synced
还没有添加看板来源，建好后不加入任何看板: No board source added yet; the issue will not be added to any board
看板「{name}」还没同步完，默认勾选没把它算进去: The board "{name}" has not finished syncing and is not in the default ticks
读不到仓库 {repo} 的里程碑（{error}）: Could not read the milestones of {repo} ({error})
托管新 issue？: Put the new issue on Autopilot?
建好后会加上标签 {autopilot} 和 {agent}。: Once created, it gets the labels {autopilot} and {agent}.
agent 接手，从方案到合并不再等人确认；独立复审通过、检查通过后由 daem: The agent takes over and goes from plan to merge without waiting for anyone; once an independent review and the checks pass, the daemon merges it.
要叫停，在网页上去掉 {autopilot} 标签。只有维护者亲手加的托管标签才: To stop it, remove the {autopilot} label on the web page. Only an Autopilot label added by a maintainer counts.
不再提示，以后点「托管」直接执行（设置里可改回）: Don't ask again; "Autopilot" acts right away from now on (can be changed back in Settings)
等前置标签这期间被摘掉或重新挂过（换了一轮等待）: The waiting label was removed or put back meanwhile (a new round of waiting)
这期间前置登记评论有新增或被改动: A prerequisite registration comment was added or edited meanwhile
等前置标签这期间被摘掉或重新挂过: The waiting label was removed or put back meanwhile
这一条的流程标签变了，可能已被转去别的流程: The item's flow labels changed; it may have been moved to another flow
「等人处理」标签仍在，不用补: The "waiting for human" label is still there; nothing to put back
登记或侧栏关系少了，不是单纯的交错登记: Registrations or sidebar relations are missing; this is not just registrations crossing
没有看到别人的新登记: No new registration by anyone else was seen
加上「{label}」暂停等待（daemon 看到它就不按任何一份登记接着干）: Add "{label}" to pause the wait (while it is on, the daemon does not resume from any registration)
在 GitHub 上把 {ref} 设成本条的「Blocked by」（侧栏 R: Set {ref} as this item's "Blocked by" on GitHub (visible under Relationships in the sidebar)
发一条登记评论，列出 {refs}（daemon 只认最新一条登记，已有的会一起: Post a registration comment listing {refs} (the daemon only counts the newest registration, so existing ones are included)
再读一遍：本轮最新登记就是这一条、期间没有别人的新登记: Read again: this is the newest registration of this round, and nobody else registered meanwhile
去掉「{label}」，开始 / 恢复等前置: Remove "{label}" to start / resume waiting for prerequisites
选的前置都已经登记过了，没有修改: The picked prerequisites are all registered already; nothing changes
没有要补做的，也没有选新的前置: Nothing left to finish, and no new prerequisite picked
{repo} 的条目缺字段: An item of {repo} is missing fields
读不到 {item} 的状态和标签: Could not read the state and labels of {item}
{item} 的标签缺名字: A label of {item} has no name
{item} 的标签记录缺字段: A label event of {item} is missing fields
{item} 的评论缺字段: A comment of {item} is missing fields
{item} 的「Blocked by」缺字段: A "Blocked by" entry of {item} is missing fields
{item} 的前置登记没有读全: The prerequisite registration of {item} could not be read in full
{item} 的前置登记分页缺少游标: A page of the prerequisite registration of {item} has no cursor
{item} 的前置登记：摘标签记录缺少时间: The prerequisite registration of {item}: a label removal has no time
{item} 的前置登记：标签记录分页超过 {n} 页，已停止: The prerequisite registration of {item}: label events run over {n} pages, stopped
{item} 的前置登记：有评论没有读到: The prerequisite registration of {item}: some comments could not be read
{item} 的前置登记：评论分页超过 {n} 页，已停止: The prerequisite registration of {item}: comments run over {n} pages, stopped
{item} 缺少读前置登记要用的 id: {item} is missing the id needed to read its prerequisite registration
{item} 的前置登记没有读到: The prerequisite registration of {item} could not be read
前置全部完成（issue 以「已完成」关闭、PR 已合并）后，daemon 把本: Once every prerequisite is done (an issue closed as completed, a PR merged), the daemon puts this item back on "{label}" to carry on.
这一条正暂停在等前置里（同时挂着「{label}」）。确认后会把没做完的补上、恢: This item is paused while waiting for prerequisites (it also has "{label}"). Confirming finishes what was left undone and resumes the wait; existing prerequisites need not be picked again.
（刚从 GitHub 读到：最新一份登记 + 侧栏 Blocked by）: (just read from GitHub: the newest registration + the sidebar's Blocked by)
较早登记里有、最新一份没有: In earlier registrations, not in the newest one
输入编号或标题，搜本仓库开着的 issue / PR: Type a number or title to search this repository's open issues / PRs
输入编号（如 429）直接定位，并列出编号以它开头的开着的条目；也可粘贴 iss: Type a number (e.g. 429) to go straight to it and list the open items whose numbers start with it; or paste an issue / PR address; or type words to search titles. ↑↓ to pick, Enter to add. For another repository write owner/repo#number — the daemon only counts repositories on the trusted list; others are handed to a human.
每一步发出前都会再读一遍；期间有变化就停在那一步，已做的会列出来。: Each step reads again before it is sent; if anything changed meanwhile, it stops at that step and lists what was done.
